basic_details.short_information: Jamnagar Mahanagarpalika (JMC) Divyang Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 27 July 2026 on the official website mcjamnagar.com. A total of 9 vacancies have been announced through the JMC Divyang Recruitment 2026 for Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), Sanitary Sub Inspector, and Junior Clerk cum Computer Operator posts.

content_sections.heading: Jamnagar Mahanagarpalika Divyang Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The recruitment is being carried out under the Special Recruitment Drive for Divyang candidates, in line with General Board Resolution No. 46 dated 25/01/2024 and the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. Only candidates with a benchmark disability of 40% or more, falling under the specified disability categories for each post, are eligible to apply under this notification. Notification PDF: Click Here Apply Online Link: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in Official Website: www.mcjamnagar.com

rows.details: Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), Sanitary Sub Inspector, Junior Clerk cum Computer Operator

content_sections.heading: Jamnagar Mahanagarpalika Divyang Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 9 posts are being filled under this Special Recruitment Drive, reserved entirely for Divyang candidates. These vacancies are being filled under the Divyang reservation quota of the administrative and technical cadre and are not available to general (non-Divyang) candidates.

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only candidates with a benchmark disability (40% or more) in the categories specified below for each post are eligible to apply. Candidates must also be an Indian citizen, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee/person of Indian origin from specified countries who has settled in India with the intention of permanent residence (subject to an eligibility certificate from the State Government where applicable). Candidates must have sufficient knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi, and English, with command over Gujarati.

rows.eligible_disability_categories: Deaf, Hard of Hearing; One Arm, One Leg, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, Multiple Disabilities involving the above

Low Vision; Deaf, Hard of Hearing; One Arm, Both Arms, One Leg, Both Legs, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, Multiple Disabilities involving the above

Blind, Low Vision; Deaf, Hard of Hearing; One Arm, Both Arms, One Leg, Both Legs, One Arm & One Leg, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy; Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness, Multiple Disabilities involving the above

rows.educational_qualification: B.Tech/Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university, OR a Diploma in Civil Engineering with 2 years of relevant experience
12th pass, along with a Government-recognized Diploma/Course for Sanitary Inspector

Graduate from a recognized university, a Government-recognized CCC course pass, and basic knowledge of computer applications as per the Gujarat Civil Service Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for Divyang candidates: 45 years Age will be calculated as on the last date of online application Age relaxation as per prevailing Gujarat Government rules is applicable to reserved-category and other eligible candidates within the Divyang pool

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a probationary basis for the first 3 years, during which they will receive the fixed monthly pay indicated above, and will need to pass departmental exams before being confirmed on the regular pay scale.

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: All Divyang candidates (across categories) must pay an application fee of ₹500/- Fee must be paid only through online mode Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted for another examination or post Last date for online fee payment: 17 August 2026, 11:59 PM

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a competitive written examination conducted by the JMC Staff Selection Committee Selected candidates will be appointed on a 3-year probationary basis During probation, candidates must pass the applicable departmental exams, computer proficiency exams, and pre-service training exams as per the recruitment rules for the respective post A provisional/waiting list is not the same as a final selection list

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for JMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Disability certificate and UDID (Unique Disability Identity Card), issued as per the Government of India's gazette notification dated 05/05/2021 Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Computer knowledge certificate/course certificate (where applicable) Proof of date of birth (SSC certificate, birth certificate, or school leaving certificate) Caste/category certificate issued by a competent authority (for reserved category applicants, where applicable) Passport-size photograph and signature in the specified format for online upload No-objection certificate (for candidates already in government/semi-government service)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for JMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official OJAS website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in Click on "Apply Online" Select the desired post to view the vacancy details Click "Apply Now" to open the application format Fill in the "Personal Details" section Fill in the "Educational Details" section Complete the "Self Declaration" section and click "Yes" to accept the terms Click "Save" — the application will be accepted online and an Application Number will be generated; note this down Upload your photograph (5 cm x 3.6 cm, JPG format, max 15 KB) and signature (2.5 cm x 3.5 cm, JPG format, max 15 KB) Click "Confirm Application" after verifying all details, as no changes are allowed post-confirmation Click "Print Application" and save a copy of the confirmed application Pay the application fee online as per the instructions provided after confirmation

content_sections.heading: JMC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This notification is applicable only to Divyang (PwD) candidates with a benchmark disability of 40% or more; other candidates are not eligible to apply under this drive No reservation for women or ex-servicemen is applicable under this Special Recruitment Drive Candidates must clearly declare the category and nature of their disability while applying online Only online applications will be accepted; no offline or physical applications will be entertained Applications with incorrect information are liable to be rejected at any stage of the recruitment process Candidates should keep their mobile number and email ID active, as all further communication will be sent to the details provided during application Candidates must appear for the competitive examination at their own expense Candidates who qualify in civil engineering can also explore more Civil Engineer Government Jobs and Gujarat Engineering Jobs across various departments. Candidates with a graduate degree and computer knowledge can check the latest Junior Clerk Recruitment and Computer Operator Government Jobs in Gujarat. Those looking for more opportunities in Jamnagar and nearby areas can browse Jamnagar Government Jobs and Gujarat Municipal Corporation Recruitment for upcoming vacancies. Divyang candidates can also explore more Divyang/PwD Government Jobs across India.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Divyang (Persons with Disabilities) candidates with a benchmark disability of 40% or more, in the categories specified for each post, can apply for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JMC Divyang Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 16 August 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies in total: 4 for Additional Assistant Engineer (Civil), 1 for Sanitary Sub Inspector, and 4 for Junior Clerk cum Computer Operator.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All Divyang candidates must pay an application fee of ₹500/- online.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Divyang candidates is 45 years, as on the last date of the online application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for JMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a competitive written examination, followed by a 3-year probation period during which candidates must clear departmental exams.

faq.question: Q7. Is this recruitment open to general (non-Divyang) candidates?
faq.answer: No. This is a Special Recruitment Drive exclusively for Divyang candidates and is not open to general candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification required for Junior Clerk cum Computer Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates need a graduate degree from a recognized university, a Government-recognized CCC course pass, and basic computer application knowledge.
